subject.title: [Performance]: Profile buildSessionEntry memory pressure during large-agent full reindex

question: Should this profiling request stay blocked on live large-agent RSS/heap proof before any parser or concurrency change is attempted?
rationale: The source path matches the suspected hotspot, but the issue intentionally lacks an observed OOM or memory bound, and changing concurrency or parsing would affect memory-core indexing behavior.

options.title: Require live profiling first
options.body: Keep this issue open until a tester captures peak RSS/heap during a large-agent full reindex, then decide whether code changes are warranted.

options.title: Sponsor a guarded investigation PR
options.body: Allow a narrow branch that adds profiling instrumentation or a reproducible benchmark without changing runtime behavior.

options.title: Close as unconfirmed
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the plausible hotspot is not worth tracking without preserved production evidence.

recommendation.title: Require live profiling first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a tester captures peak RSS/heap during a large-agent full reindex, then decide whether code changes are warranted.
